testcase.name: Scenario: Switch customization targets by keyboard with an edit pending: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:857:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch customization targets by keyboard with an edit pending ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ And the Part Manage target is empty ✔ When the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the available list ✔ And the user opens the custom panel target selector ✔ And the user presses Down and Enter to select Part Manage ✔ Then the Part Manage custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ And Apply and cancels are enabled ✔ When the user opens the custom panel target selector ✔ And the user presses Up and Enter to select Part Tools ✔ Then the Part Tools target has a pending-change marker ✔ And "2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
